CustomField.description: Gives hyper link of pledge record and provides all the list of primary donors related to that Pledge
CustomField.formula: HYPERLINK("/?sort="& IF( Pledge__r.Anonymous__c , Pledge__r.Pledge_Name_Amount__c, Pledge__r.Pledge_Name_Amount__c),'' ) & HYPERLINK ("/"+Pledge__r.Id, IF( Pledge__r.Anonymous__c , Pledge__r.Pledge_Name_Amount__c , Pledge__r.Pledge_Name_Amount__c) , '_self')
CustomField.label: Primary Donor
